semantic_audit.selection_limit: The batch sample is small and the targeted review deliberately includes ambiguity and scope risks. Counts do not estimate an error rate.

cso.explanation: Existing pinned topic mappings remain under evidence CI. The snapshot fetch returned HTTP 403 in the release workspace so no new CSO relation projection was reviewed locally.

mathlib4.explanation: Lean module imports are source dependency metadata. Only explicitly reviewed declarations contribute scientific claims.

ontomath-edu.explanation: Pinned OWL axioms remain in staging. The license is unverified and the mathematical-object/formula partition must be preserved before any scoped projection.

ontomath-pro.explanation: The existing named restriction profile retains reviewed range constraints. Those universal constraints leave existence unspecified.

opencs.explanation: The native links are taxonomy, topical associations, and mapping references. Reviewed neighboring topics corroborate identities; the generic links do not establish an algorithmic or mathematical predicate.

openmath.explanation: The release covers reviewed FMPs and symbol bindings in the selected dictionaries. Other files require checks of their license notices, semantics, and symbol bindings.
